title: Longest Word
prompt: A reading app highlights the longest word in a sentence. Write a function that ignores punctuation at the start or end of each word, then returns the first longest word it finds.

explanation.beginner:
Example: longestWord("Build small reliable helpers") produces "reliable". The result must follow this precise rule: A reading app highlights the longest word in a sentence. Write a function that ignores punctuation at the start or end of each word, then returns the first longest word it finds. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “ignores punctuation”: input ["Wait... observability wins!"] produces "observability". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
